name: perspective-squeeze
title: Perspective Squeeze
description: Two lines of heavy type endlessly trade height while corner-pinned perspective bends the flat stack into receding planes.
useWhen: A looping hold (an outro, a background title, a stream screen) needs constant, hypnotic typographic motion.
You want an editorial poster feel: heavy condensed type crushed and stretched like a print layout come alive.
Two short words can share the frame: both lines are forced to the same width.
avoidWhen: You need an entrance or a reveal: the type is fully visible from the first frame; use kinetic-warp.
The copy must stay easily readable throughout: lines spend most of the loop crushed to a third of their height.
You only need the vertical stretch without the perspective bend.
author: Remocn
